jamie.prodsec: Quick sync — we need to finalize audit coverage for the RBAC schema changes + KMS key rotation feature. Who can sanity-check customer-facing event names? :eyes:
sofia.eng: I can take a pass. Do we want separate events for key-attach/key-rotate or a single `kms.change` with a subtype?
maria.sre: From an ops perspective we need clear indicators for automated rollback triggers. Prefer explicit events e.g., `kms.key.rotate` and `kms.key.attach` so alerts can be scoped.
raj.ml: Also flagging that model-serving calls will surface the `kms_key_id` in events — we should confirm that never leaks PII and is consistent with KMS naming.
jamie.prodsec: Good point. We should also ensure RBAC events include both intent and result. Example pattern I sketched: `auth.role.requested` (intent) + `auth.role.granted|denied` (outcome).
sofia.eng: +1. For customer-facing validation we need a stable `event_type` string and a small enum for `outcome`. Draft schema snippet below (for discussion):
```json
{
  "event_type": "auth.role.granted",
  "actor": {"id": "user_123", "type": "user"},
  "resource": {"type": "project", "id": "proj_987"},
  "changes": {"from": "viewer", "to": "editor"},
  "kms_key_id": "projects/prod/keys/k-01",
  "outcome": "success",
  "audit_metadata": {"src": "console", "ip": "1.2.3.4"}
}
```
ethan.legal: We should redact or hash any KMS ARN when exporting to customer logs unless customer explicitly requests full key path. Legal needs a short note on that.
maria.sre: Ops: also include `deployment_context` when events come from Dedicated/Private so we can filter customer vs infra actions.
jamie.prodsec: Action items: @sofia.eng to propose final event_type naming table; @raj.ml to add KMS redaction rules; @maria.sre to define deployment_context values; @ethan.legal to confirm redaction policy language. I'll draft a short compatibility note for existing customers.
security-bot: New doc created: RFC - audit-events/kms-rbac-compatibility (link: https://wiki.internal/rfcs/234). :white_check_mark:
sofia.eng: I'll post a PR with the proposed name table by EOD. Quick checklist request: do we need versioning in the event envelope (e.g., `schema_version`) or rely on `event_type` namespacing?
raj.ml: prefer explicit `schema_version` at top-level — easier to handle parsing fallback.
jamie.prodsec: agree. Add `schema_version` and timestamp.
ethan.legal: Also confirm retention and export defaults in the RFC. I'll review once Sofia's PR lands. :thumbsup:
maria.sre: If anyone wants to test sample events through the staging pipeline I can wire up a small replay job. ping me after the PR.
sofia.eng: Thanks team — will follow up in the PR with concrete event_type list and example customers-facing docs. :pray:
